STYLE — CHINESE INK-WASH ACTION PAINTING (this replaces the house European-oil look for these memory flashbacks only): a violent shuimo ink painting on aged xuan paper, brushed in one breath. Xu Beihong's galloping ink horses, Liang Kai's splashed ink (pomo), Ma Yuan's one-corner diagonals, Bada Shanren's empty paper. Bodies built from a few huge loaded strokes of wet black ink that bleed and bloom into the paper; manes, tails, dust and wind as dry-brush FLYING WHITE (feibai) streaks where the bristles split; ink splatter and spray flung off every impact like blood and mud; speed shown by long dry-brush sweeps and smeared ink trails, not by cartoon lines. Value range from dense lacquer-black to bare paper, almost no colour: the paper is pale warm ivory and IS the sky, the snow, the haze and the distance — at least half the frame left empty. ONE colour only, as a translucent wash dropped into the wet ink: the horse's coat colour (or cinnabar for blood and the prince's war-robe) — nothing else coloured. Faces and figures drawn with a few sharp calligraphic ink lines, simplified and expressive — never photoreal, never 3D, never a smooth digital render. DRAMA AND PACE: the frozen instant of maximum action — the leap, the impact, the arrow striking, the collapse; an extreme diagonal or a body hurtling toward the viewer in hard foreshortening; dutch angles, worm's-eye or plunging bird's-eye; cropped bodies bursting past the frame edge; the composition tilts and moves. HORSES are the heroes and are painted to be admired — powerful, anatomically true (deep chest, arched neck, round haunch, legs in a real gallop or rear), muscle carved by the direction of the brushstroke. Enemies are faceless ink blots, spear-thickets and smears, never individuals, never named. One small blank cinnabar seal square in a corner with NO characters. Horizontal 2:1 handscroll section: composed for a 2:1 letterbox crop; nothing important at the top or bottom edge. No readable text, no Chinese characters, no calligraphy inscriptions, no colophons, no signatures, no banners with glyphs. No watermark.
